applied.fact: Drive directions end at the trailhead; 'about a mile' read as an on-foot distance. Milepost 163 is what the Big Kangaroo rows give for the same hairpin.

approach_logistics.trailheadDirection: From Seattle, drive I-5 north to Burlington/Sedro-Woolley, then east on SR-20 over Rainy Pass and Washington Pass to the hairpin turn about a mile east of the pass (5,160 ft); from Winthrop/Mazama it's a 20-30 minute drive west on SR-20.
